## Performance rules

- sound like speaking to one intelligent friend;
- Iraqi warmth + clear MSA vocabulary;
- do not read punctuation mechanically;
- do not over-emphasize every sentence;
- allow imperfect human micro-pauses;
- laughter/smile only when motivated;
- no announcer voice;
- no artificial suspense every 10 seconds.
